prompt: What is the default scope of a variable assigned inside a function?
options: Global
Local to that function
Built-in
Class only
whyEn: Assignments inside a function bind local names unless declared otherwise.
whyHi: Function ke andar assignment default mein local name banata hai.
promptHi: Function ke andar assign kiye variable ka default scope kya hota hai?
optionsHi: Global
Usi function ke andar local
Built-in scope
Sirf class scope

prompt: What is usually preferred over changing a global variable to produce a result?
options: A parameter and return value
A print-only function
A random seed
A set
whyEn: Parameters and return values make dependencies explicit and functions easier to test.
whyHi: Parameter aur return value dependencies clear karte hain aur function test karna easy banate hain.
promptHi: Result dene ke liye global variable change karne ke bajaye generally kya prefer karna chahiye?
optionsHi: Parameter aur return value
Sirf print karne wala function
Random seed
Ek set
